import { Effect } from "./effect.js";
import { RandomGUID } from "../Misc/guid.js";
import { DrawWrapper } from "./drawWrapper.js";
import { EngineStore } from "../Engines/engineStore.js";
import { Observable } from "../Misc/observable.js";
class MapMap {
    constructor() {
        this.mm = new Map();
    }
    get(a, b) {
        const m = this.mm.get(a);
        if (m !== undefined) {
            return m.get(b);
        }
        return undefined;
    }
    set(a, b, v) {
        let m = this.mm.get(a);
        if (m === undefined) {
            this.mm.set(a, (m = new Map()));
        }
        m.set(b, v);
    }
}
/**
 * Class that can be used to wrap a base material to generate accurate shadows when using custom vertex/fragment code in the base material
 */
export class ShadowDepthWrapper {
    /** Gets the standalone status of the wrapper */
    get standalone() {
        return this._options?.standalone ?? false;
    }
    /** Gets the base material the wrapper is built upon */
    get baseMaterial() {
        return this._baseMaterial;
    }
    /** Gets the doNotInjectCode status of the wrapper */
    get doNotInjectCode() {
        return this._options?.doNotInjectCode ?? false;
    }
    /**
     * Instantiate a new shadow depth wrapper.
     * It works by injecting some specific code in the vertex/fragment shaders of the base material and is used by a shadow generator to
     * generate the shadow depth map. For more information, please refer to the documentation:
     * https://doc.babylonjs.com/features/featuresDeepDive/lights/shadows
     * @param baseMaterial Material to wrap
     * @param scene Define the scene the material belongs to
     * @param options Options used to create the wrapper
     */
    constructor(baseMaterial, scene, options) {
        this._baseMaterial = baseMaterial;
        this._scene = scene ?? EngineStore.LastCreatedScene;
        this._options = options;
        // WebGPU only: metadata tokens, never an Effect/resource cache.
        this._depthTokens = this._scene.getEngine().isWebGPU ? new WeakMap() : null;
        this._depthDisposed = false;
        this._subMeshToEffect = new Map();
        this._subMeshToDepthWrapper = new MapMap();
        // Base notifications borrow the material's Effect. Each canonical source
        // pass owns independent derived entries; aliases own draw contexts only.
        this._subMeshToEffectByPass = this._depthTokens ? new Map() : null;
        this._subMeshToDepthWrapperByPass = this._depthTokens ? new Map() : null;
        this._depthPassObserver = this._depthTokens
            ? (this._scene.getEngine()._onReleaseRenderPassObservable ??= new Observable()).add((pass) => this._releaseDepthPass(pass))
            : null;
        this._meshes = new Map();
        // Register for onEffectCreated to store the effect of the base material when it is (re)generated. This effect will be used
        // to create the depth effect later on
        this._onEffectCreatedObserver = this._baseMaterial.onEffectCreatedObservable.add((params) => {
            if (this._depthDisposed) return;
            const mesh = params.subMesh?.getMesh();
            if (mesh && !this._meshes.has(mesh)) {
                // Register for mesh onDispose to clean up our internal maps when a mesh is disposed
                this._meshes.set(mesh, mesh.onDisposeObservable.add((mesh) => {
                    const iterator = this._subMeshToEffect.keys();
                    for (let key = iterator.next(); key.done !== true; key = iterator.next()) {
                        const subMesh = key.value;
                        if (subMesh?.getMesh() === mesh) {
                            this._subMeshToEffect.delete(subMesh);
                            this._subMeshToEffectByPass?.delete(subMesh);
                            this._deleteDepthWrapperEffect(subMesh);
                        }
                    }
                    if (this._depthTokens) this._meshes.delete(mesh);
                }));
            }
            if (this._depthTokens) {
                const pass = this._scene.getEngine().currentRenderPassId;
                if (!params.subMesh || this._isDepthPassReleased(pass)) return;
                let passes = this._subMeshToEffectByPass.get(params.subMesh);
                if (!passes) this._subMeshToEffectByPass.set(params.subMesh, (passes = new Map()));
                const previous = passes.get(pass);
                const source = previous?.[0] === params.effect ? previous : [params.effect, pass];
                // Keep real notification order without allocating on reads.
                passes.delete(pass);
                passes.set(pass, source);
                this._subMeshToEffect.set(params.subMesh, source);
                if (previous?.[0] !== params.effect) this._deleteDepthWrapperEffect(params.subMesh, pass);
            }
            else if (this._subMeshToEffect.get(params.subMesh)?.[0] !== params.effect) {
                this._subMeshToEffect.set(params.subMesh, [params.effect, this._scene.getEngine().currentRenderPassId]);
                this._deleteDepthWrapperEffect(params.subMesh);
            }
        });
    }
    _deleteDepthWrapperEffect(subMesh, pass) {
        if (this._depthTokens) {
            const generators = this._subMeshToDepthWrapperByPass.get(subMesh);
            if (!generators) return;
            const retired = [], aliases = [];
            if (pass === undefined) {
                this._subMeshToDepthWrapperByPass.delete(subMesh);
                this._subMeshToDepthWrapper.mm.delete(subMesh);
                for (const entries of generators.values()) retired.push(...entries.values());
            }
            else {
                for (const [generator, entries] of [...generators]) {
                    const entry = entries.get(pass);
                    if (entry) { entries.delete(pass); retired.push(entry); }
                    for (const other of entries.values()) {
                        const alias = other.drawWrapper[pass];
                        if (alias) {
                            delete other.drawWrapper[pass];
                            aliases.push(alias);
                        }
                    }
                    this._updateDepthFacade(subMesh, generator, entries);
                }
            }
            this._releaseDepthResources(retired, aliases);
            return;
        }
        const depthWrapperEntries = this._subMeshToDepthWrapper.mm.get(subMesh);
        if (depthWrapperEntries) {
            // find and release the previous depth effect
            depthWrapperEntries.forEach((depthWrapper) => {
                if (this._depthTokens) this._releaseDepthEntry(depthWrapper);
                else depthWrapper.mainDrawWrapper.effect?.dispose();
            });
            this._subMeshToDepthWrapper.mm.delete(subMesh); // trigger a depth effect recreation
        }
    }
    _releaseDepthEntry(entry) {
        if (entry.released) return;
        entry.released = true;
        const effect = entry.mainDrawWrapper.effect;
        // Each entry acquired once. Pass aliases must not each release it.
        let failed = false, failure;
        for (const wrapper of new Set([entry.mainDrawWrapper, ...entry.drawWrapper.filter(Boolean)])) {
            try { wrapper.effect = null; wrapper.dispose(true); }
            catch (error) { if (!failed) { failed = true; failure = error; } }
        }
        try { if (effect && !effect.isDisposed) effect.dispose(); }
        catch (error) { if (!failed) { failed = true; failure = error; } }
        if (failed) throw failure;
    }
    _releaseDepthResources(entries, aliases = []) {
        let failed = false, failure;
        for (const alias of aliases) {
            try { alias.effect = null; alias.dispose(true); }
            catch (error) { if (!failed) { failed = true; failure = error; } }
        }
        for (const entry of new Set(entries)) {
            try { this._releaseDepthEntry(entry); }
            catch (error) { if (!failed) { failed = true; failure = error; } }
        }
        if (failed) throw failure;
    }
    _isDepthPassReleased(pass) {
        if (!Number.isSafeInteger(pass) || pass < 0) return true;
        const names = this._scene.getEngine()._renderPassNames;
        // Native release writes an own undefined slot. Synthetic legacy holes
        // remain supported without retaining a history/tombstone cache.
        return names && Object.hasOwn(names, pass) && names[pass] === undefined;
    }
    _depthEntries(subMesh, generator, create = false) {
        let generators = this._subMeshToDepthWrapperByPass.get(subMesh);
        if (!generators && create) this._subMeshToDepthWrapperByPass.set(subMesh, (generators = new Map()));
        let entries = generators?.get(generator);
        if (!entries && create) generators.set(generator, (entries = new Map()));
        return entries;
    }
    _getDepthSource(subMesh, requestedPass) {
        if (this._depthDisposed || this._isDepthPassReleased(requestedPass)) return undefined;
        const passes = this._subMeshToEffectByPass.get(subMesh);
        // A known requested source wins even when pending: never substitute an
        // older ready Effect for a notified hot-swap that has not settled yet.
        if (passes?.has(requestedPass)) return passes.get(requestedPass);
        // Nonstandalone custom materials prepare their base in a normal pass.
        // Requested draw contexts can borrow only that exact live notification.
        const source = this._subMeshToEffect.get(subMesh);
        return source && passes?.get(source[1]) === source && !this._isDepthPassReleased(source[1]) ? source : undefined;
    }
    _updateDepthFacade(subMesh, generator, entries) {
        let current;
        for (const entry of entries.values()) current = entry;
        if (current) this._subMeshToDepthWrapper.set(subMesh, generator, current);
        else {
            const generators = this._subMeshToDepthWrapperByPass.get(subMesh);
            generators?.delete(generator);
            if (!generators?.size) this._subMeshToDepthWrapperByPass.delete(subMesh);
            const legacy = this._subMeshToDepthWrapper.mm.get(subMesh);
            legacy?.delete(generator);
            if (!legacy?.size) this._subMeshToDepthWrapper.mm.delete(subMesh);
        }
    }
    _releaseDepthPass(pass) {
        // ObjectRenderer releases its uninitialized slots before assigning IDs.
        // Undefined is also the internal delete-all sentinel, never a pass.
        if (this._depthDisposed || !Number.isSafeInteger(pass) || pass < 0) return;
        let failed = false, failure;
        const subMeshes = new Set([...this._subMeshToEffectByPass.keys(), ...this._subMeshToDepthWrapperByPass.keys()]);
        for (const subMesh of subMeshes) {
            const bases = this._subMeshToEffectByPass.get(subMesh);
            bases?.delete(pass);
            if (!bases?.size) this._subMeshToEffectByPass.delete(subMesh);
            if (this._subMeshToEffect.get(subMesh)?.[1] === pass) {
                const latest = bases && [...bases.values()].at(-1);
                if (latest) this._subMeshToEffect.set(subMesh, latest);
                else this._subMeshToEffect.delete(subMesh);
            }
            try { this._deleteDepthWrapperEffect(subMesh, pass); }
            catch (error) { if (!failed) { failed = true; failure = error; } }
        }
        if (failed) throw failure;
    }
    _getDepthProgramToken(original, vertexCode, fragmentCode, options, fallback) {
        let signature;
        try {
            const lists = [options.attributes, options.uniformsNames, options.uniformBuffersNames, options.samplers];
            const copied = [];
            for (const list of lists) {
                if (!Array.isArray(list)) return fallback;
                const names = [];
                for (let index = 0; index < list.length; index++) {
                    const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(list, String(index));
                    if (!descriptor || !("value" in descriptor) || typeof descriptor.value !== "string") return fallback;
                    names.push(descriptor.value);
                }
                copied.push(names);
            }
            const parameters = options.indexParameters;
            let indexes;
            if (parameters === undefined) indexes = ["undefined"];
            else if (parameters === null) indexes = ["null"];
            else {
                if (Object.getPrototypeOf(parameters) !== Object.prototype && Object.getPrototypeOf(parameters) !== null) return fallback;
                indexes = ["object"];
                for (const key of Reflect.ownKeys(parameters)) {
                    if (typeof key !== "string") return fallback;
                    const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(parameters, key);
                    if (!descriptor || !("value" in descriptor)) return fallback;
                    const value = descriptor.value, type = typeof value;
                    if (value !== null && type !== "string" && type !== "boolean" && type !== "undefined" && (type !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value))) return fallback;
                    indexes.push([key, type, type === "number" && Object.is(value, -0) ? "-0" : value]);
                }
            }
            if (typeof vertexCode !== "string" || typeof fragmentCode !== "string" || !Number.isSafeInteger(options.shaderLanguage)) return fallback;
            signature = JSON.stringify([vertexCode, fragmentCode, options.shaderLanguage, copied, indexes]);
        } catch { return fallback; }
        const previous = this._depthTokens.get(original);
        if (previous?.signature === signature) return previous.token;
        const token = RandomGUID();
        this._depthTokens.set(original, { signature, token });
        return token;
    }
    /**
     * Gets the effect to use to generate the depth map
     * @param subMesh subMesh to get the effect for
     * @param shadowGenerator shadow generator to get the effect for
     * @param passIdForDrawWrapper Id of the pass for which the effect from the draw wrapper must be retrieved from
     * @returns the effect to use to generate the depth map for the subMesh + shadow generator specified
     */
    getEffect(subMesh, shadowGenerator, passIdForDrawWrapper) {
        let entry;
        if (this._depthTokens) {
            const source = this._getDepthSource(subMesh, passIdForDrawWrapper);
            if (!source) return null;
            entry = this._depthEntries(subMesh, shadowGenerator)?.get(source[1]);
            if (entry?.originalEffect !== source[0]) return null;
        }
        else entry = this._subMeshToDepthWrapper.mm.get(subMesh)?.get(shadowGenerator);
        if (!entry) {
            return null;
        }
        let drawWrapper = entry.drawWrapper[passIdForDrawWrapper];
        if (!drawWrapper) {
            drawWrapper = entry.drawWrapper[passIdForDrawWrapper] = new DrawWrapper(this._scene.getEngine());
            drawWrapper.setEffect(entry.mainDrawWrapper.effect, entry.mainDrawWrapper.defines);
        }
        return drawWrapper;
    }
    /**
     * Specifies that the submesh is ready to be used for depth rendering
     * @param subMesh submesh to check
     * @param defines the list of defines to take into account when checking the effect
     * @param shadowGenerator combined with subMesh, it defines the effect to check
     * @param useInstances specifies that instances should be used
     * @param passIdForDrawWrapper Id of the pass for which the draw wrapper should be created
     * @returns a boolean indicating that the submesh is ready or not
     */
    isReadyForSubMesh(subMesh, defines, shadowGenerator, useInstances, passIdForDrawWrapper) {
        if (this._depthDisposed) return false;
        if (this.standalone) {
            // will ensure the effect is (re)created for the base material
            if (!this._baseMaterial.isReadyForSubMesh(subMesh.getMesh(), subMesh, useInstances)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return this._makeEffect(subMesh, defines, shadowGenerator, passIdForDrawWrapper)?.isReady() ?? false;
    }
    /**
     * Disposes the resources
     */
    dispose() {
        if (this._depthTokens && this._depthDisposed) return;
        if (this._depthTokens) this._depthDisposed = true;
        this._baseMaterial.onEffectCreatedObservable.remove(this._onEffectCreatedObserver);
        this._onEffectCreatedObserver = null;
        const iterator = this._meshes.entries();
        for (let entry = iterator.next(); entry.done !== true; entry = iterator.next()) {
            const [mesh, observer] = entry.value;
            mesh.onDisposeObservable.remove(observer);
        }
        if (this._depthTokens) {
            this._scene.getEngine()._onReleaseRenderPassObservable?.remove(this._depthPassObserver);
            this._depthPassObserver = null;
            const retired = [];
            for (const generators of this._subMeshToDepthWrapperByPass.values())
                for (const entries of generators.values()) retired.push(...entries.values());
            this._subMeshToDepthWrapperByPass.clear();
            this._subMeshToEffectByPass.clear();
            this._subMeshToDepthWrapper.mm.clear();
            this._subMeshToEffect.clear();
            this._meshes.clear();
            this._depthTokens = new WeakMap();
            this._releaseDepthResources(retired);
        }
    }
    _makeEffect(subMesh, defines, shadowGenerator, passIdForDrawWrapper) {
        if (this._depthDisposed) return null;
        const engine = this._scene.getEngine();
        const origEffectAndRenderPassId = this._depthTokens
            ? this._getDepthSource(subMesh, passIdForDrawWrapper)
            : this._subMeshToEffect.get(subMesh);
        if (!origEffectAndRenderPassId) {
            return null;
        }
        const [origEffect, origRenderPassId] = origEffectAndRenderPassId;
        if (!origEffect || !origEffect.isReady() || (this._depthTokens && origEffect.isDisposed)) {
            return null;
        }
        let params = this._depthTokens
            ? this._depthEntries(subMesh, shadowGenerator)?.get(origRenderPassId)
            : this._subMeshToDepthWrapper.get(subMesh, shadowGenerator);
        if (!params) {
            const mainDrawWrapper = new DrawWrapper(engine);
            const originalDefines = subMesh._getDrawWrapper(origRenderPassId)?.defines;
            mainDrawWrapper.defines = typeof originalDefines === "string" ? null : (originalDefines ?? null);
            params = {
                drawWrapper: [],
                mainDrawWrapper,
                depthDefines: "",
                token: RandomGUID(),
            };
            params.drawWrapper[this._depthTokens ? origRenderPassId : passIdForDrawWrapper] = mainDrawWrapper;
            this._subMeshToDepthWrapper.set(subMesh, shadowGenerator, params);
            if (this._depthTokens) {
                params.origPass = origRenderPassId;
                params.originalEffect = origEffect;
                this._depthEntries(subMesh, shadowGenerator, true).set(origRenderPassId, params);
            }
        }
        const join = defines.join("\n");
        if (params.mainDrawWrapper.effect) {
            if (join === params.depthDefines && (!this._depthTokens || !params.mainDrawWrapper.effect.isDisposed)) {
                // we already created the depth effect and it is still up to date for this submesh + shadow generator
                return params.mainDrawWrapper.effect;
            }
        }
        if (!this._depthTokens) params.depthDefines = join;
        const uniforms = origEffect.getUniformNames().slice();
        // the depth effect is either out of date or has not been created yet
        let vertexCode = origEffect.vertexSourceCodeBeforeMigration, fragmentCode = origEffect.fragmentSourceCodeBeforeMigration;
        if (!vertexCode && !fragmentCode) {
            return null;
        }
        if (!this.doNotInjectCode) {
            // Declare the shadow map includes
            // Native material varyings are qualified; explicit normal remaps still win.
            const normalBiasRemapping = origEffect.shaderLanguage === 1 /* ShaderLanguage.WGSL */ &&
                !this._options?.remappedVariables?.some((name, index) => index % 2 === 0 && name === "vNormalW")
                ? [...(this._options?.remappedVariables ?? []), "vNormalW", "vertexOutputs.vNormalW"]
                : this._options?.remappedVariables;
            const vertexNormalBiasCode = normalBiasRemapping
                ? `#include<shadowMapVertexNormalBias>(${normalBiasRemapping.join(",")})`
                : `#include<shadowMapVertexNormalBias>`, vertexMetricCode = this._options && this._options.remappedVariables
                ? `#include<shadowMapVertexMetric>(${this._options.remappedVariables.join(",")})`
                : `#include<shadowMapVertexMetric>`, fragmentSoftTransparentShadow = this._options && this._options.remappedVariables
                ? `#include<shadowMapFragmentSoftTransparentShadow>(${this._options.remappedVariables.join(",")})`
                : `#include<shadowMapFragmentSoftTransparentShadow>`, fragmentBlockCode = `#include<shadowMapFragment>`, vertexExtraDeclartion = `#include<shadowMapVertexExtraDeclaration>`;
            // vertex code
            if (origEffect.shaderLanguage === 0 /* ShaderLanguage.GLSL */) {
                vertexCode = vertexCode.replace(/void\s+?main/g, `\n${vertexExtraDeclartion}\nvoid main`);
            }
            else {
                vertexCode = vertexCode.replace(/@vertex/g, `\n${vertexExtraDeclartion}\n@vertex`);
            }
            vertexCode = vertexCode.replace(/#define SHADOWDEPTH_NORMALBIAS|#define CUSTOM_VERTEX_UPDATE_WORLDPOS/g, vertexNormalBiasCode);
            if (vertexCode.indexOf("#define SHADOWDEPTH_METRIC") !== -1) {
                vertexCode = vertexCode.replace(/#define SHADOWDEPTH_METRIC/g, vertexMetricCode);
            }
            else {
                vertexCode = vertexCode.replace(/}\s*$/g, vertexMetricCode + "\n}");
            }
            vertexCode = vertexCode.replace(/#define SHADER_NAME.*?\n|out vec4 glFragColor;\n/g, "");
            // fragment code
            const hasLocationForSoftTransparentShadow = fragmentCode.indexOf("#define SHADOWDEPTH_SOFTTRANSPARENTSHADOW") >= 0 || fragmentCode.indexOf("#define CUSTOM_FRAGMENT_BEFORE_FOG") >= 0;
            const hasLocationForFragment = fragmentCode.indexOf("#define SHADOWDEPTH_FRAGMENT") !== -1;
            let fragmentCodeToInjectAtEnd = "";
            if (!hasLocationForSoftTransparentShadow) {
                fragmentCodeToInjectAtEnd = fragmentSoftTransparentShadow + "\n";
            }
            else {
                fragmentCode = fragmentCode.replace(/#define SHADOWDEPTH_SOFTTRANSPARENTSHADOW|#define CUSTOM_FRAGMENT_BEFORE_FOG/g, fragmentSoftTransparentShadow);
            }
            if (origEffect.shaderLanguage === 1 /* ShaderLanguage.WGSL */) {
                fragmentCode = fragmentCode.replace(/@fragment/g, "#include<shadowMapFragmentExtraDeclaration>\n@fragment");
            }
            else {
                fragmentCode = fragmentCode.replace(/void\s+?main/g, Effect.IncludesShadersStore["shadowMapFragmentExtraDeclaration"] + "\nvoid main");
            }
            if (hasLocationForFragment) {
                fragmentCode = fragmentCode.replace(/#define SHADOWDEPTH_FRAGMENT/g, fragmentBlockCode);
            }
            else {
                fragmentCodeToInjectAtEnd += fragmentBlockCode + "\n";
            }
            if (fragmentCodeToInjectAtEnd) {
                fragmentCode = fragmentCode.replace(/}\s*$/g, fragmentCodeToInjectAtEnd + "}");
            }
            uniforms.push("biasAndScaleSM", "depthValuesSM", "lightDataSM", "softTransparentShadowSM");
        }
        const effectOptions = {
            attributes: origEffect.getAttributesNames(),
            uniformsNames: uniforms,
            uniformBuffersNames: origEffect.getUniformBuffersNames(),
            samplers: origEffect.getSamplers(),
            defines: join + "\n" + origEffect.defines.replace("#define SHADOWS", "").replace(/#define SHADOW\d/g, ""),
            indexParameters: origEffect.getIndexParameters(),
            shaderLanguage: origEffect.shaderLanguage,
        };
        const token = this._depthTokens
            ? this._getDepthProgramToken(origEffect, vertexCode, fragmentCode, effectOptions, params.token)
            : params.token;
        const nextEffect = engine.createEffect({
            vertexSource: vertexCode,
            fragmentSource: fragmentCode,
            vertexToken: token,
            fragmentToken: token,
        }, effectOptions, engine);
        if (this._depthTokens) {
            // A synchronous engine callback may retire the current entry.
            if (this._getDepthSource(subMesh, passIdForDrawWrapper) !== origEffectAndRenderPassId || this._depthEntries(subMesh, shadowGenerator)?.get(origRenderPassId) !== params || origEffect.isDisposed) {
                if (!nextEffect.isDisposed) nextEffect.dispose();
                return null;
            }
            const previousEffect = params.mainDrawWrapper.effect;
            params.depthDefines = join;
            for (const wrapper of new Set([params.mainDrawWrapper, ...params.drawWrapper.filter(Boolean)]))
                wrapper.setEffect(nextEffect, params.mainDrawWrapper.defines);
            if (previousEffect && !previousEffect.isDisposed) previousEffect.dispose();
            return nextEffect;
        }
        params.mainDrawWrapper.effect = nextEffect;
        for (let id = 0; id < params.drawWrapper.length; ++id) {
            if (id !== passIdForDrawWrapper) {
                params.drawWrapper[id]?.setEffect(params.mainDrawWrapper.effect, params.mainDrawWrapper.defines);
            }
        }
        return params.mainDrawWrapper.effect;
    }
}
//# sourceMappingURL=shadowDepthWrapper.js.map
